headline_marked: [[PM Tarique Rahman returns home]] after attending UNGA session in New York
headline: PM Tarique Rahman returns home after attending UNGA session in New York
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has returned to Dhaka after a five-day visit to the United States, where he attended the 81st session of the UN General Assembly and held numerous meetings. He made a stopover in Dubai on his way back.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has returned to Bangladesh after concluding his visit to New York, USA, where he attended the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly. His flight landed at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka this Sunday morning.

According to the Prime Minister's Press Wing, the aircraft carrying the Prime Minister and his entourage touched down at 8:20 AM. This marks the end of his five-day official visit to the United States.

The Emirates flight, carrying the Prime Minister, his wife Zubaida Rahman, and their companions, departed from John F. Kennedy International Airport in New York at 11:30 PM local time on September 25. The flight made a stopover in Dubai before continuing its journey to Dhaka.

During his visit to New York, the Prime Minister participated in approximately 30 important and fruitful meetings, sessions, and programs at various levels, in addition to attending the General Assembly session. He also delivered a speech at the General Assembly session for the first time.
caption:
Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has returned to Dhaka after a significant five-day visit to the United States, including his first address at the UN General Assembly.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has returned to Bangladesh after concluding his visit to New York, USA, where he attended the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly. His flight landed at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka this Sunday morning.

According to the Prime Minister's Press Wing, the aircraft carrying the Prime Minister and his entourage touched down at 8:20 AM. This marks the end of his five-day official visit to the United States.

The Emirates flight, carrying the Prime Minister, his wife Zubaida Rahman, and their companions, departed from John F. Kennedy International Airport in New York at 11:30 PM local time on September 25. The flight made a stopover in Dubai before continuing its journey to Dhaka.

During his visit to New York, the Prime Minister participated in approximately 30 important and fruitful meetings, sessions, and programs at various levels, in addition to attending the General Assembly session. He also delivered a speech at the General Assembly session for the first time.

headline_marked: [[Armed gang attacks housing project and Salman Muqtadir's studio]], loots Tk 1 crore; 2 held
headline: Armed gang attacks housing project and Salman Muqtadir's studio, loots Tk 1 crore; 2 held
summary: An armed group allegedly opened fire, vandalized property, and looted approximately Tk 1 crore from a housing society office in Dhaka's South Manikdi. Content creator Salman Muqtadir's studio was also attacked and ransacked in the incident.
details: An armed group allegedly attacked the New Guinea Housing Project and content creator Salman Muqtadir's studio in Dhaka's South Manikdi on Saturday night. The incident, reportedly driven by extortion demands, led to the looting of approximately Tk 1 crore from the housing society office.

Witnesses reported that over a hundred masked individuals arrived in four pickup vans, opening fire indiscriminately in the residential area. They systematically destroyed CCTV cameras across the housing complex during the assault.

Several individuals were reportedly injured with sharp weapons, while computers, mobile phones, and other valuable items were looted. The housing authorities claim that about Tk 1 crore was stolen from their office.

The housing project directors allege that the attackers demanded a large sum of money and attempted to seize purchased land. This marks the second such attack in two months, with similar extortion demands made previously.

Salman Muqtadir's studio was also vandalized, and his staff were reportedly assaulted. Expressing frustration, Muqtadir stated he would have paid the extortion if he could, also voicing a lack of faith in the country's legal system.
Police arrived at the scene, leading to an exchange of gunfire between the two sides. Two individuals were subsequently arrested, and a case is currently being processed at Cantonment Police Station.
caption:
An armed gang attacked a housing project and content creator Salman Muqtadir's studio in Dhaka, looting Tk 1 crore and injuring several. Police have arrested two suspects.

An armed group allegedly attacked the New Guinea Housing Project and content creator Salman Muqtadir's studio in Dhaka's South Manikdi on Saturday night. The incident, reportedly driven by extortion demands, led to the looting of approximately Tk 1 crore from the housing society office.

Witnesses reported that over a hundred masked individuals arrived in four pickup vans, opening fire indiscriminately in the residential area. They systematically destroyed CCTV cameras across the housing complex during the assault.

Several individuals were reportedly injured with sharp weapons, while computers, mobile phones, and other valuable items were looted. The housing authorities claim that about Tk 1 crore was stolen from their office.

The housing project directors allege that the attackers demanded a large sum of money and attempted to seize purchased land. This marks the second such attack in two months, with similar extortion demands made previously.

Salman Muqtadir's studio was also vandalized, and his staff were reportedly assaulted. Expressing frustration, Muqtadir stated he would have paid the extortion if he could, also voicing a lack of faith in the country's legal system.

Police arrived at the scene, leading to an exchange of gunfire between the two sides. Two individuals were subsequently arrested, and a case is currently being processed at Cantonment Police Station.
